title: Will my child be interacting only with the same Speech Therapist in every session?
metaTitle: Consistent Interaction with Speech Therapist - Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Learn how Pinnacle Blooms Network assigns a dedicated Speech Therapist to your child for an enhanced therapeutic relationship, promoting more efficient and meaningful progress in your child's communication skills.
html: At Pinnacle Blooms Network, we understand the significant role that familiarity plays in your child's comfort and progress. Therefore, we generally assign one Speech Therapist to accompany your child throughout their therapy journey. This consistent interaction fosters a better understanding and rapport between therapist and child, promoting meaningful progression in each of the sessions.
